description:
Look up coordinates and a short street address for a free-text address.

Include the postcode in the address: it helps a lot. Check `precise`: when
false, only a town or street was matched and the coordinates are an
approximate area centre. Check `routable` too: false means Delopt has no
road data for that place yet and plans there are refused.

query.description: Free-text address: street, number, town. Including the postcode helps a lot.
query.title: Query

name: geocode_address

precise.description: False when only a town or street was matched, so lat/lon is an approximate area centre rather than the address itself
precise.title: Precise

routable.description: False when this place is outside the regions Delopt has road data for, so plans there are refused (see delopt://guide/getting-started)
routable.title: Routable
